d: Watch the match highlights and all goals from Senegal vs Iraq in Group I of the FIFA World Cup 2026 at Toronto Stadium in Toronto, Canada. After Habib Diarra opened the scoring inside four minutes and Iraq's Rebin Sulaka was sent off for a red card following a VAR review, Senegal exploded in the second half through Ismaïla Sarr, a quickfire brace from substitute Pape Gueye, and a late strike from Iliman Ndiaye to seal a commanding 5-0 victory.
